fullDescription: A clean white-card profile card showcase on a soft dotted slate canvas with a single emerald accent: the hero pairs a bold 'The profile card, perfected.' headline (emerald gradient on the last word) with the star component, a 380px rounded white profile card holding a ringed circular avatar + verified badge, name and role, a 3-column stat row (Projects / Followers / Following), a short bio, skill tags, and a Follow + Message action pair. Below: a 4-up 'built from deliberate parts' anatomy grid, a full-bleed dark copy-the-prompt code panel, and a footer. Inter, slate 'ink' neutrals + emerald accent, sticky translucent blurred nav, reflows from a 2-col hero to a single column below lg.
prompt: ## Resumo A clean, modern component-showcase landing page built around a single hero component: a shippable user profile card. The hero pairs a bold 'The profile card, perfected.' headline (the word 'perfected.' in an emerald gradient) and a copy-the-prompt CTA beside the star card itself, a ~380px wide rounded white card on a soft dotted slate 'canvas' holding a ring-shadowed circular avatar with a verified badge, a name + role, a 3-column stat row (Projects / Followers / Following) divided by hairlines, a short bio, three skill tags, and a primary Follow + secondary Message button pair. Below the hero: a 4-up 'built from deliberate parts' anatomy grid (Identity / Stats / Tags / Actions), a full-bleed dark 'ship this in one prompt' section with a terminal-style code panel, and a footer. Sticky translucent blurred top nav; the hero reflows from a 2-col grid to a single centered column below lg. ## Estilo Visual Design a clean, modern component-showcase landing page using the Inter font family (weights 400-900, antialiased) on a white page with a soft dotted slate canvas behind the hero. Palette is a single emerald accent over a full slate 'ink' neutral scale. ink: 950 #0b1220, 900 #0f172a (primary text / dark logo tile / dark section bg), 800 #1e293b, 700 #334155, 600 #475569, 500 #64748b (body text), 400 #94a3b8 (muted captions), 300 #cbd5e1, 200 #e2e8f0 (borders), 100 #f1f5f9 (hairline borders), 50 #f8fafc (tinted fills / page base). emerald: 50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981 (primary accent / buttons), 600 #059669 (accent hover / role text), 700 #047857 (eyebrow text / gradient start). Use emerald as the only chromatic UI color; everything else is the slate neutral scale plus white. Headlines are font-extrabold with tight tracking (tracking-tight) and tight leading (hero leading-[1.05]); the last hero word uses an emerald text-gradient (linear-gradient 90deg #047857 -> #10b981, background-clip:text). The hero sits on a 'canvas-grid': bg #f8fafc with a radial-gradient dot pattern (circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,23,42,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid). Rounding: pills/badges rounded-full, cards rounded-2xl (16px), the hero profile card rounded-[28px], icon tiles rounded-xl. Shadows are soft and slate-tinted: the hero card uses a 3-layer card-shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 40px 60px -24px rgba(15,23,42,0.14)); the avatar uses an avatar-ring (0 0 0 4px #ffffff, 0 0 0 6px #d1fae5, 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(16,185,129,0.55)); emerald buttons use btn-follow-shadow (0 8px 18px -6px rgba(16,185,129,0.55)). Hover: anatomy cards shift border to emerald-200 and bg to emerald-50/40; emerald buttons darken emerald-500 -> emerald-600. Center the page content in a max-w-7xl container. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky top nav A full-width sticky header (sticky top-0, z-50) with a translucent white background (bg-white/80) + a backdrop-filter blur (saturate(180%) blur(12px)) and a 1px ink-100 #f1f5f9 bottom border. Inner row h-16 (64px), max-w-7xl, px-6 lg:px-8, items-center justify-between. Left: brand lock-up = a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl ink-900 #0f172a tile holding a white Iconify lucide 'square-stack' glyph at 18px, beside the wordmark 'Cardly' at 17px font-extrabold tracking-tight ink-900 with a trailing emerald-500 '.' period. Center (md+ only): nav links 'Showcase / Components / Prompts / Docs' at 14px font-medium ink-600 #475569 that darken to ink-900 on hover, gap-8. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (ink-600, sm+ only) and a 'Get started' pill (bg-ink-900 #0f172a, white text, rounded-full, px-4 py-2, 14px font-semibold, trailing lucide arrow-right) that lightens to ink-800 on hover. ### Hero / Showcase (copy + profile card) A relative overflow-hidden section with a canvas-grid background (bg #f8fafc + radial-dot grid) and a 1px ink-100 bottom border, plus a pointer-events-none ambient emerald glow: a 520px circular emerald-200/40 blob, blur-3xl, pinned -top-40 and centered. Inner grid max-w-7xl, px-6 lg:px-8, py-20 lg:py-28, items-center, gap-16, lg:grid-cols-2. LEFT copy column (text-center lg:text-left): a rounded-full pill badge (emerald-200 border, emerald-50 #ecfdf5 fill, 12px uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold emerald-700 #047857, leading lucide 'sparkles' icon) reading 'Component of the week'; an h1 'The profile card, perfected.' at text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> lg:text-6xl font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight ink-900, where 'perfected.' uses the emerald text-gradient (#047857 -> #10b981); a 18px (text-lg) ink-500 #64748b leading-relaxed lead paragraph (max-w-md) describing the card; a button row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row) with a primary emerald pill 'Copy the prompt' (bg-emerald-500 #10b981, white text, rounded-full, px-6 py-3, font-semibold, leading lucide 'copy' icon, btn-follow-shadow, hover bg-emerald-600) and a secondary outlined pill 'Browse library' (ink-200 border, white fill, ink-700 text, hover border-ink-300 + bg-ink-50); and a wrap row of three trust items at 12px font-medium ink-400, each a leading emerald-500 lucide 'check-circle-2' icon + label ('Tailwind ready', 'Fully responsive', 'Accessible'). RIGHT: the profile card (see component), in a max-w-[380px] container, justified center on mobile and lg:justify-end. ### The profile card (hero component) Inside a w-full max-w-[380px] column, a relative white article card: rounded-[28px], 1px ink-100 border, bg-white, p-8, card-shadow (3-layer soft slate shadow). At the very top, an absolute centered accent bar (h-1 w-24, rounded-b-full, bg-emerald-500). Stacked, centered content: (1) AVATAR block - a relative 112px (h-28 w-28) circular avatar, overflow-hidden, with a from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600 gradient backing and an avatar-ring glow (white + emerald-100 rings + emerald drop shadow), holding a portrait ; a verified badge pinned bottom-right = a 28px (h-7 w-7) circle, 3px white border, bg-emerald-500, white lucide 'check' glyph. (2) NAME block (mt-5) - an h2 name 'Mara Whitfield' at text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight ink-900, and a role line 'Senior Product Designer' at 14px font-medium emerald-600 #059669. (3) STAT row (mt-7) - a 3-col grid divided by vertical ink-100 dividers, inside a rounded-2xl 1px ink-100 border on an ink-50/60 fill, py-4; each cell centered: a figure at text-lg font-extrabold ink-900 ('1.2k' / '8.5k' / '4.7k') over an 11px uppercase tracking-wide font-medium ink-400 caption ('Projects' / 'Followers' / 'Following'). (4) BIO (mt-6) - a centered 14px ink-500 leading-relaxed paragraph. (5) TAGS (mt-5) - a centered flex-wrap of three rounded-full pills at 12px font-semibold: the first 'UI/UX' filled (emerald-200 border, emerald-50 fill, emerald-700 text), the rest 'Branding' / 'Motion' outlined (ink-200 border, white fill, ink-600 text). (6) ACTIONS (mt-7) - a 2-col grid gap-3: a primary 'Follow' button (bg-emerald-500, white text, rounded-xl, py-3, font-semibold, leading lucide 'user-plus' icon, btn-follow-shadow, hover emerald-600) and a secondary 'Message' button (ink-200 border, white fill, ink-700 text, rounded-xl, py-3, leading lucide 'mail' icon, hover border-ink-300 + bg-ink-50). ### Anatomy / Components grid A white section (bg-white) with a 1px ink-100 bottom border. Inner max-w-7xl, px-6 lg:px-8, py-20. A centered header block (max-w-2xl): an h2 'Built from deliberate parts' at text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight ink-900, and an 18px ink-500 lead 'Every element earns its place. Nothing decorative, everything legible.'. Below, a 4-up grid (mt-14, gap-6, sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) of feature cards: each rounded-2xl, 1px ink-100 border, bg ink-50/50, p-6, hover -> border-emerald-200 + bg-emerald-50/40; inside, a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl white tile with a soft shadow holding a 20px emerald-600 #059669 lucide icon ('circle-user-round' / 'bar-chart-3' / 'tags' / 'mouse-pointer-click'), an h3 title at 16px font-bold ink-900 ('Identity' / 'Stats' / 'Tags' / 'Actions'), and a 14px ink-500 leading-relaxed body. ### Dark prompt CTA + code panel A full-bleed dark section (bg-ink-950 #0b1220). Inner max-w-7xl, px-6 lg:px-8, py-20, grid items-center gap-10 lg:grid-cols-2. LEFT: an h2 'Ship this card in one prompt' at text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight white, a 18px ink-400 #94a3b8 leading-relaxed lead (max-w-md), and an emerald pill CTA 'Open in the canvas' (bg-emerald-500, white text, rounded-full, px-6 py-3, font-semibold, leading lucide 'wand-sparkles' icon, btn-follow-shadow, hover bg-emerald-400). RIGHT: a terminal-style code panel = rounded-2xl, 1px ink-800 #1e293b border, bg-ink-900 #0f172a, p-1.5, shadow-2xl; a top bar (px-4 py-2.5, items-center gap-2) with a leading emerald-400 #34d399 lucide 'terminal' icon, a 'prompt.txt' label (12px font-medium ink-400), and a right-aligned 'Copy' button (11px font-semibold ink-500 + lucide copy icon); a code body (overflow-x-auto, rounded-xl, bg-ink-950 #0b1220, p-5, font-mono 12-13px leading-relaxed ink-300 #cbd5e1) of the natural-language prompt, with the leading verb 'Design' tinted emerald-400, the key nouns '3-column stat row' and 'Follow' tinted emerald-300 #6ee7b7, and a trailing '// white card . ink slate . emerald accent . Inter' comment in ink-500. ### Footer A 1px ink-100 top border footer on bg-white. Inner max-w-7xl, px-6 lg:px-8, py-10, flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-center justify-between, gap-4. Left: the brand lock-up = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg ink-900 tile with a white lucide 'square-stack' glyph + the 'Cardly' wordmark (14px font-bold ink-900, emerald-500 trailing period). Center: a 14px ink-400 tagline 'A component showcase. Built with Tailwind + Inter.'. Right: three ink-400 social icon links (lucide github / twitter / figma) that darken to ink-700 on hover. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Componente Profile card (the hero component): a white rounded-[28px] card (1px ink-100 border, p-8) with a 3-layer soft slate card-shadow and a top centered emerald-500 accent bar (h-1 w-24, rounded-b-full); stacks a ringed circular avatar + verified badge, name + role, a bordered 3-up stat block, a bio, skill-tag pills, and a Follow + Message button pair. ### Componente Ringed avatar with verified badge: a 112px circular avatar on a from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600 gradient backing with an avatar-ring glow (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px #ffffff, 0 0 0 6px #d1fae5, 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(16,185,129,0.55)) and a 28px bottom-right verified badge (3px white border, bg-emerald-500, white lucide check). ### Componente Divided 3-up stat block: a rounded-2xl 1px ink-100 border on an ink-50/60 fill, py-4, with three centered cells separated by vertical ink-100 dividers (figure at text-lg font-extrabold ink-900 over an 11px uppercase tracking-wide ink-400 caption). ### Componente Skill-tag pills: rounded-full 12px font-semibold chips, one filled emerald (emerald-200 border / emerald-50 fill / emerald-700 text) and the rest outlined slate (ink-200 border / white fill / ink-600 text). ### Componente Emerald + outlined button pair: a primary emerald-500 button with a btn-follow-shadow (0 8px 18px -6px rgba(16,185,129,0.55)) darkening to emerald-600 on hover, paired with a quiet outlined ink-200 button that gains an ink-300 border + ink-50 fill on hover. ### Componente Sticky translucent blurred top nav (bg-white/80 + backdrop blur saturate(180%) blur(12px), 1px ink-100 bottom border) with a dark ink-900 logo tile and a dark 'Get started' pill. ### Componente Dotted slate 'canvas' (canvas-grid: bg #f8fafc + radial-gradient rgba(15,23,42,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid) with an ambient emerald glow (a 520px emerald-200/40 blob, blur-3xl) behind the hero. ### Componente Lift-into-emerald anatomy cards: rounded-2xl ink-100-bordered ink-50/50 cards whose border shifts to emerald-200 and bg to emerald-50/40 on hover, each with a white icon tile holding an emerald-600 lucide glyph. ### Componente Dark terminal-style code panel (bg-ink-900 outer / bg-ink-950 code body, 'prompt.txt' bar + Copy button) with syntax-tinted prompt text (emerald-400 verb, emerald-300 key nouns, ink-500 comment). ### Componente Emerald text-gradient headline word (linear-gradient 90deg #047857 -> #10b981, background-clip:text) on a single hero word. ## Notas Especiais Single-accent system: emerald is the only chromatic color (50 #ecfdf5 / 100 #d1fae5 / 200 #a7f3d0 / 300 #6ee7b7 / 400 #34d399 / 500 #10b981 / 600 #059669 / 700 #047857); everything else is the slate 'ink' neutral scale (950 #0b1220 / 900 #0f172a / 800 #1e293b / 700 #334155 / 600 #475569 / 500 #64748b / 400 #94a3b8 / 300 #cbd5e1 / 200 #e2e8f0 / 100 #f1f5f9 / 50 #f8fafc) plus white, so emerald always reads as the action/accent. ONE typeface: Inter (weights 400-900) via Google Fonts; headlines use font-extrabold with tracking-tight (hero leading-[1.05]). All hex values are exact and should be preserved, including the three custom box-shadow recipes (card-shadow, avatar-ring, btn-follow-shadow), the canvas-grid dot pattern (rgba(15,23,42,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid), the emerald headline text-gradient (#047857 -> #10b981) and the code-panel syntax tints (emerald-400 verb, emerald-300 nouns). Icons are Iconify lucide (lucide:*) glyphs. No em-dashes in any copy. The whole page is centered in a max-w-7xl container and reflows from the 2-col hero to a single centered column below lg (nav center links hide below md, the Sign in link below sm).

structured.special_notes: Single-accent system: emerald is the only chromatic color (50 #ecfdf5 / 100 #d1fae5 / 200 #a7f3d0 / 300 #6ee7b7 / 400 #34d399 / 500 #10b981 / 600 #059669 / 700 #047857); everything else is the slate 'ink' neutral scale (950 #0b1220 / 900 #0f172a / 800 #1e293b / 700 #334155 / 600 #475569 / 500 #64748b / 400 #94a3b8 / 300 #cbd5e1 / 200 #e2e8f0 / 100 #f1f5f9 / 50 #f8fafc) plus white, so emerald always reads as the action/accent. ONE typeface: Inter (weights 400-900) via Google Fonts; headlines use font-extrabold with tracking-tight (hero leading-[1.05]). All hex values are exact and should be preserved, including the three custom box-shadow recipes (card-shadow, avatar-ring, btn-follow-shadow), the canvas-grid dot pattern (rgba(15,23,42,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid), the emerald headline text-gradient (#047857 -> #10b981) and the code-panel syntax tints (emerald-400 verb, emerald-300 nouns). Icons are Iconify lucide (lucide:*) glyphs. No em-dashes in any copy. The whole page is centered in a max-w-7xl container and reflows from the 2-col hero to a single centered column below lg (nav center links hide below md, the Sign in link below sm).
